# Syed Uzaif — Mobile Product Engineer

> Syed Uzaif is a Mobile Product Engineer who combines Flutter engineering, product ownership, and visual storytelling to build, improve, and release production mobile applications for Android and iOS.

## About

- Name: Syed Uzaif
- Title: Mobile Product Engineer (product-minded Flutter developer and creative technologist)
- Based in: Karachi, Pakistan. Open to remote opportunities and relocation to Islamabad or Rawalpindi.
- Positioning: I turn unclear ideas into thoughtful mobile products by combining engineering, product thinking, visual judgment, and end-to-end ownership.

## Evidence

- Nearly two years of production Flutter experience.
- Contributed to applications with 10,000+ cumulative downloads across Google Play and the App Store.
- Shipped on both Android and iOS.
- Reduced a production app's initial load time from ~3.2s to ~1.76s (about 45% faster).
- Owns work end to end: build, QA coordination, and store releases.

## Featured work

- SimpliEd — a production education platform (LMS) for students, parents, and schools. Owns mobile features, performance, offline behaviour, and Android/iOS releases across two live Student and Parent apps and an offline-first Teacher app (encrypted local database with Drift + sqlite3mc, durable outbox sync, reactive Riverpod 3.x UI). The platform has 10,000+ cumulative downloads across the Play Store and App Store — a team/product outcome, not a personal acquisition claim. Production work under confidentiality.
- Budget Buddy — an independent budgeting product designed to reduce the friction of recording expenses and maintaining financial habits, with an AI advisor as a supporting feature (not the point). Offline-first capture that syncs when online. In active development, not yet published. Repo: https://github.com/syeduzaif/Budget-buddy
- Stupid Alarm — a behavioural product experiment exploring whether physical posture detection (e.g. sitting up) can reduce unconscious snoozing while staying safe and accessible. Concept/prototype in Flutter, documented as a build-in-public series; effectiveness not yet validated. Repo: https://github.com/syeduzaif/stupid_alarm_flutter
